title: Cedar Crest Golf Course

services.name: Rentals
services.desc: We are members of Washington State Women’s Public Links Association and Snohomish County Women’s Golf Association. Play expectations are following PGA and Course rules, and completing 18 holes within 4.5 hours. This club can help you advance your game by regular play, but we are not a teaching league. If you said yes to any of these, we’d like to invite you to join our Cedarcrest Women’s golf league. We are a friendly group of women golfers from beginners to serious competitors. blurb: Built in 1927, Cedarcrest Golf Course is Snohomish County’s most established public golf facility. Located two miles east of Interstate 5, Cedarcrest is a favorite for golfers of all skill levels.
